# Comments at the end of the lines of a call's arguments are kept.
celfmt -i member.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_member.txt

celfmt -i want_member.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_member.txt

celfmt -i macro.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_macro.txt

celfmt -i want_macro.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_macro.txt

celfmt -i first.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_first.txt

celfmt -i want_first.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_first.txt

-- member.cel --
state.x.with(
	state.y // c1
)
-- want_member.txt --
state.x.with(
	state.y // c1
)
-- macro.cel --
state.x.as(y,
	y.z.as(w,
		w + 1 // c2
	)
)
-- want_macro.txt --
state.x.as(y,
	y.z.as(w,
		w + 1 // c2
	)
)
-- first.cel --
state.x.as(y, // c4
	y + 1
)
-- want_first.txt --
state.x.as(y, // c4
	y + 1
)
